mods.aiSummary: Converts vanilla and modded textures into DDS format with BC7 compression to reduce VRAM usage.

mods.name: VRI Flashbang White Edition
mods.summary: This is the what Gunmetal was originally meant to be.

mods.name: VRI Gunmetal Edition
mods.summary: This skinpack was an accident that occurred while I was making a shitpost of VRI (Cumstain Flashbang White Edition).

mods.name: Vulpoids - Lost Project
mods.summary: The technological might of the Domain created an endless variety of technologies - some of which were rife with, to quote the Luddics, "corruption, depravity, hedonism, and transhuman abomination".
mods.aiSummary: Adds artificial servitor lifeforms called Vulpoids, featuring new industries, commodities, population systems, and interactive dialogues.

mods.name: Warhammer 40000: Banished Imperium
mods.summary: After spending a century in isolation due to a terrible warp storm, Tesalia, sector capital, finds itself free in a strange corner of the galaxy; full of non-imperial human civilizations ripe for conquest, strange technologies, and no knowledge of the God Emperor.
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Imperium of Man from Warhammer 40.000 as a fully functional NPC faction with its own system, 12 new spaceships and 9 new weapons.

mods.name: Weapon Arcs
mods.summary: This is a simple mod that draws the weapon arcs of all weapons groups on the players ship, in contrast to vanilla which only draws the selected group.
mods.aiSummary: Draws weapon arcs for all weapon groups on the player's ship simultaneously.

mods.name: Weapons Group Controls
mods.summary: A utility mod that adds some rebindable in-combat hotkeys:
mods.aiSummary: Adds rebindable in-combat hotkeys for managing weapon groups.

mods.name: Weebshit AI portrait pack
mods.summary: What it says on the tin

mods.name: Weebshit Extended
mods.summary: You already know you want this. Weebify the sector!

mods.name: Weftin's Ship Pack
mods.summary: Adds 21 Midline ships (with some high tech flavor added in) to the sector.
mods.aiSummary: Adds 21 midline ships with high-tech flavor to the sector.

mods.name: Well Advised Modifications
mods.summary: Turns Ill Advised Modifications into a harmless flavor mod
mods.aiSummary: Turns Ill Advised Modifications into a harmless flavor mod.

mods.name: WH Rogue Trader Portrait Pack V1.0
mods.summary: Citizens of the Imperium REJOICE! From this day onward you can spread the light of the God Emperor to the sector! Be it alone or with your trusty seneschal Abelard at your side!
mods.aiSummary: Adds over 80 Warhammer-themed portraits and 10 officer chatter personalities.

mods.name: What We Left Behind
mods.summary: This mod focuses on exploration and colony content, with a particular incline towards cosmic horror and esoteric nonsense. Various terrifying secrets exist in the reaches of the sector, waiting for you to discover them.
mods.aiSummary: Adds exploration and colony content with a focus on cosmic horror and interconnected world reactions.

mods.name: WhichMod
mods.summary: This mod adds the mod title to the descriptions of all weapons, ships, fighters, and hullmods added by mods.
mods.aiSummary: Adds the originating mod's name to the descriptions of all weapons, ships, fighters, and hullmods added by mods.

mods.name: WhichTMI
mods.summary: Look who just leveled up. yaml

mods.name: WhichTMI
mods.summary: WhichTMI adds subtext with exact numerical info for some weapon stats that are otherwise hidden from the player one way or another. This mod does not add anything fancy and is only intended to be used as a companion to TMI, or as a lightweight variation on it.
mods.aiSummary: Adds subtext with exact numerical info for some weapon stats that are otherwise hidden from the player.

mods.name: Whisper's Techmining Alterations
mods.summary: * Techmining is a structure, not infrastructure (since it doesn't benefit the faction/planet directly)
mods.aiSummary: Overhauls techmining mechanics by treating it as a structure with decay rates, progress bars for special items, and configurable loot values based on ruins and colony size.

mods.name: Wide Horizons
mods.summary: Wide Horizons lets you expand the Starsector galaxy by up to 300%. With in-game setting, the entire universe scales up: sector size, star systems, ruins, Remnants, gates, and more.
mods.aiSummary: Expands the galaxy by up to 300% with scalable sectors, realistic system generation, and adjusted gameplay mechanics.

mods.name: Wingman Project: Online Combat Co-op battles for Starsector.(BETA)
mods.summary: Co-op multiplayer for Starsector battles. One player hosts a battle (a mission, the simulator or a campaign fight) and up to three friends(default, goes up to 16 but why would you do that?) join it, each flying a ship from the host's fleet, side by side, in real time.
mods.aiSummary: Adds co-op multiplayer for Starsector battles, letting up to three friends join a host's fight in real time.

mods.name: WIP - Beyond The Black: a BSG and The Expanse inspired hard sci fi mod
mods.summary: This mod is basically the two shows mixed together, with a few Starsector things added in as well as flavor.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a hard sci-fi combat system inspired by Battlestar Galactica and The Expanse, featuring custom factions, ships, and weapons with no shields.

mods.name: WIP Aardwolf & Zenith: ARRUS Hullmods 0.89
mods.summary: A modest collection of additional hullmods to help customise the way you like to play. Most of the included hullmods are based off augmenting or offsetting a variety of vanilla hullmods. As such most of them have dependencies on vanilla hullmods and/or each other.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a collection of hullmods for customizing ship builds, including augmentations, reversions, rectifications, upgrades, and stopgaps.

mods.name: Wishgranters Faction
mods.summary: From left to right we have:
mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction featuring ships with heavy armor, strong support wings, and high-volume fire.

mods.name: Wondrous Weapons
mods.summary: -A content expansion pack for Starsector, featuring many common ships, weapons, and (more content to come!)
mods.aiSummary: Adds many common ships and weapons as a content expansion.

mods.name: Wow Portraits
mods.summary: Ok, so it's not that WoW (World of Warcraft) kind of Portraits, but hear me out. This Mod aims to replace the Vanilla portraits and add some extra, to make the game feel more SciFi. As a Disclaimer: These portraits have been generated with Easy Stable Difussion, but trust me it was no easy task.
mods.aiSummary: Replaces vanilla character portraits with AI-generated sci-fi images.

mods.name: Xhan Empire
mods.summary: Two factions, one a fully fledged militaristic and zealous faction focused on heavy armor and formation warfare. Ships and weapons that range from utilitarian to exotic with their own internally consistent design philosophy and tech levels.
mods.aiSummary: Adds two new factions, the militaristic Xhan Empire and the economic United Pamed, along with their unique ships, weapons, and campaign content.

mods.name: Xxarra's Variety Pack
mods.summary: Mod adds 60+ new ships, exploration and quest content, custom starts, multiple unique bounties, and additions to existing Vanilla content.
mods.aiSummary: Adds over 60 new ships, exploration and quest content, custom starts, and unique bounties.

mods.name: XXVII Battle group v0.9.7
mods.summary: Add a mid-tech battle group. Having some vanilla-like ships. Having some special faction weapons, but all of these are build-in their ships.

mods.name: Yellow
mods.summary: The Ynadar Alliance was bit of an inside joke to complete the triad of the three primary color factions I was told to do.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a faction focused on a midline armada with long-range missiles and weapons.

mods.name: Yuki's Tactical Display
mods.summary: Adds a tactical display widget to the combat UI anchored to the left side of the screen, with configurable position. Shows your fleet along with their assignments and status, as well as flux bars and CR/PPT in visual form.
mods.aiSummary: Adds a configurable tactical display widget to the combat UI showing fleet status, assignments, and flux bars.

mods.name: Yunru Mods
mods.summary: YunruCore is, in essence, a library mod for all my other mods. For me, it makes it easier to use programmes like the Ship and Weapon Editor, but for you the user, it allows you to enable and disable the other mods listed here at will without losing your saves.
mods.aiSummary: Acts as a library mod that enables other Yunru mods to be toggled without losing saves.

mods.name: Yuri Expedition
mods.summary: This mod adds the new faction, Caparice Trade Co. in the Sola system in the eastern fringe of the sector.
mods.aiSummary: Adds the Caparice Trade Co. faction, featuring glass cannon ships with extensive missile loadouts and heavily armored bruisers.

mods.name: ZA WARUDO
mods.summary: Turns phase and temporal shell into a jojo reference.

mods.name: Zer0Morph's Waving Banners
mods.summary: Turns all faction banners into something more... wavy
mods.aiSummary: Replaces faction banners with animated, wavy flag textures.

mods.name: ZORG

mods.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with unique ships, weapons, and a custom campaign system.
